acceptance.scope: shared working tree, owned Markov Gradient changes with other existing uncommitted work

policy_reference.note: Snapshot of the accepted native policy.

source.source_oracle: Pinned node, shader, shader-function helpers, and palette/random constructors.

summary: Bounded Markov Gradient native CPU pixels for all seven controls, ordered palette replacement, raw source channels, mapped chance, global frame seed, whole-batch work/byte admission and native/PXC persistence. Joined batch71 passes; no licensed or GPU pixel-parity claim.

physical_controls.native_rule: When Active is true, require an observed numeric seed. Do not invent a fixed fallback.
Typed booleans are direct. Finite numeric values are true only when greater than 0.5. Active arrays are unsupported.

physical_controls.default: Source copies the current project palette at construction.
physical_controls.native_rule: For unlinked catalogue-default input, resolve from the current durable project palette. Authored or linked palette values take precedence.

synthetic_controls.replace_chance_mapped: Default false; enables mapped chance behavior.

native_profile.inactive_behavior: Clone the complete input image array before row evaluation, preserving tree shape, order, and formats. Skip seed and effect/control arrays on this path.
native_profile.seed_frame: Add the raw authored/runtime seed to CURRENT_FRAME in double precision, then cast to shader float. Do not add a local clock or processor-row offset.
native_profile.chance_map: Nearest sample at output UV; use raw mean RGB and ignore map alpha. The native R-only sample profile is (r,0,0,1), giving chance-map mean r/3.
native_profile.mapping: Honor replace_chance_mapped and replace_chance_map_range. Preserve linked raw Replace Chance precedence.
native_profile.replacement: Compare original source RGB distance to palette RGB in order. On the first distance less than or equal to Threshold, replace the whole RGBA value with the following palette entry and stop. Do not chain or wrap the final entry.
native_profile.palette: Support flat palettes, processor-selected nested palettes, and singleton Color getters. Refuse empty palettes and palettes larger than the shader's 256-entry capacity.
native_profile.packed_color_limit: PXC JSON decoding may convert integral numbers into RGBA Color values and lose integer-versus-real provenance. Source colToVec4 alpha behavior differs for packed int64 values, so that imported representation distinction is a stated persistence limit.
native_profile.source_sampling: Bounded nearest CPU sampling profile. GPU sampling and licensed numeric backend parity are unverified.
native_profile.palette_animation: Undriven raw first/final palette endpoints persist and execute. Between-key nested palette arithmetic refuses atomically on colors.

core_coverage.fixture_scope: Independent pixel oracle for palette replacement order, packed colors, chance maps, frame timing and inactive cloning; exact threshold boundary; alpha replacement; palette fallback and explicit precedence; nested palette rows; linked and mapped chance inputs; finite-value, missing-seed, palette-shape, work, byte, and whole-batch refusal.

io_coverage.fixture_scope: Seven source ports and links, grouping, mapped range, physical edits, threshold and nested palette key preservation, Global Tick and Subframe seed behavior, four processor-array modes, inactive whole-array cloning, current project palette fallback versus explicit palette precedence, flat and nested palettes through native/PXC save and reopen, R8 base sampling, RGBA8 active output, and scalar Process=false execution.
io_coverage.refusals: Opaque preservation for malformed palette, seed, chance range, and extra input; nested palette bounds; low import budget; missing active seed; synthetic edits; stale bytes; and invalid projections must preserve prior source, graph, or output state.

workload_coverage.fixture_scope: Seven input formats, flat and nested palettes, exact CPU pixel and image-hash checks, mapped chance, profile and allocation counters, inactive cloning, and atomic aggregate work or byte refusal.

workload_counters.timing_output: kept in memory only; no benchmark timing file

validation.logs_and_hashes: Recorded per-check log paths and SHA-256 hashes; source and child binaries stable.

limitations: A missing active source seed is unsupported because the source constructor seed_random(6) value is not stored as a fixed default.
The reference executable is unavailable; licensed numeric backend, GPU, and live runtime parity remain unknown.
PXC decoding can lose packed int64 versus real-number provenance for palette colors.
Physical Atlas inputs and attribute_process=false outer arrays are unsupported.
Offscreen Vulkan checks were previously authorized; live Studio verification was not run.
Other uncommitted work exists in the shared tree; the isolated committed tree was not separately rebuilt.
Undriven raw palette endpoints are supported; nested palette interpolation and numeric palette drivers are unverified and unsupported.
